checked_classes: recommendation coverage — all REC-001 through REC-061 are assigned to a change and each assigned spec includes a report acceptance coverage requirement or C01 reconciliation gate

dependency ordering — later changes declare prerequisite changes or profile-specific gates before depending on their capabilities; C13 adds explicit profile prerequisite gates for C11/C12-dependent modes

scope and implementation readiness — artifacts consistently mark initiative tasks as planning delivery groups and require repository-scoped child tasks, file claims, checkpoints and acceptance links before product implementation

authority boundary contradictions — specs consistently separate execution, supervision, approval, data, observer, connector, human-representation and console authorities without granting authority from role titles, transport, UI rendering, CRDT writes or harness portability

acceptance testability — acceptance clauses use observable outcomes such as denied effects, preserved identities, refusal diagnostics, crash/restart behavior, revocation behavior, exact revisions and real-boundary scenarios rather than relying only on subjective success claims
